# Independent BigQuery answers: tools/kll/sampler.answers.txt.
# Retained mass includes the sampler and need not equal the original input count.
SELECT [KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 0.4), KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 0.400001), KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 0.8), KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 0.800001)] FROM (SELECT FROM_HEX('0871100420048a071d080310011a01012201042a0212002a041202010232070a010410011801') AS s)
=> [{"v":"1"},{"v":"3"},{"v":"3"},{"v":"4"}]

SELECT [KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 0.5), KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 0.51), KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 0.533), KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 0.534)] FROM (SELECT FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010071803') AS s)
=> [{"v":"4"},{"v":"4"},{"v":"4"},{"v":"16"}]

SELECT [KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_FLOAT64(s, 0.413), KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_FLOAT64(s, 0.414), KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_FLOAT64(s, 0.827), KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_FLOAT64(s, 0.828)] FROM (SELECT FROM_HEX('0871108120200a8a0769080310011a0800000000000070c0220800000000000070402a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a120a1000000000004867c00000000000f85240320f0a080000000000946b4010d606180b') AS s)
=> [{"v":"-186.25"},{"v":"75.875"},{"v":"75.875"},{"v":"220.625"}]

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010001803'), 0.75)
=> "4"

# Exact extrema and INT64 values are preserved; the independent array extraction
# answers in tools/kll/followup.answers.txt cover the same endpoint/median ranks.
SELECT [KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 0.0), KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 0.5), KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 1.0)] FROM (SELECT FROM_HEX('0871100320048a073e088a1710e8071a0a808080808080808080012209ffffffffffffffff7f2a1f121d8080808080808080800180808080808080808001ffffffffffffffff7f') AS s)
=> [{"v":"-9223372036854775808"},{"v":"0"},{"v":"9223372036854775807"}]

# Argument validation: tools/kll/quantiles.answers.txt. These checks precede
# NULL-sketch handling, and phi must be constant.
SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_FLOAT64(CAST(NULL AS BYTES), 1.1)
=> error contains: must be between 0 and 1

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_FLOAT64(b'bad', CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64))
=> error contains: must be between 0 and 1

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(b'bad', CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64))
=> error contains: must be non-NULL

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(b'bad', phi) FROM UNNEST([0.0, 0.5, 1.0]) AS phi
=> error: Argument #2 must be constant; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64 expression

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_FLOAT64(b'bad', phi) FROM UNNEST([0.0, 0.5, 1.0]) AS phi
=> error: Argument #2 must be constant; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_FLOAT64 expression

# Maintainer-recorded BigQuery follow-up: tools/kll/point.answers.txt.
SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(CAST(NULL AS BYTES), 0.5)
=> null

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_FLOAT64(CAST(NULL AS BYTES), 0.5)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(b'bad', 0.5)
=> error contains: SAFE with function kll_quantiles.extract_point_int64 is not supported

SELECT SAFE.KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_FLOAT64(b'bad', 0.5)
=> error contains: SAFE with function kll_quantiles.extract_point_float64 is not supported

SELECT [KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 0.39999999999999997), KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_POINT_INT64(s, 0.4000000000000001)] FROM (SELECT FROM_HEX('0871100420048a071d080310011a01012201042a0212002a041202010232070a010410011801') AS s)
=> [{"v":"1"},{"v":"3"}]
